pkgmove safety report: example.com/fx/hub -> example.com/fx/hub/sub
Files moved: 1. Findings: 6. Errors: 0.

Why this matters: a moved package is initialised before the package that
imports it, so init() functions and package-level var initialisers in the moved
files now run before every initialiser of the source package. Review each
ERROR/HIGH/WARN item below before merging.

== WARN: package-level var initialiser calls other packages ==
  hub/move.go:16: upper = ... calls strings.Map: it now runs before every var initialiser and init() of hub, so state they set (environment, defaults, registries) is no longer visible to it, and its own effects happen earlier
  hub/move.go:19: label = ... calls fmt.Sprint: it now runs before every var initialiser and init() of hub, so state they set (environment, defaults, registries) is no longer visible to it, and its own effects happen earlier
  hub/move.go:25: kind = ... calls reflect.Value.Kind, reflect.ValueOf: it now runs before every var initialiser and init() of hub, so state they set (environment, defaults, registries) is no longer visible to it, and its own effects happen earlier

== WARN: package-level var initialiser reads other packages' vars ==
  hub/move.go:28: out = ... reads os.Stderr: it now runs before every initialiser of hub, so changes they make to those vars are no longer visible to it

== WARN: reflect-visible type name changes (all users, not only moved files) ==
  hub/move.go:11: hub.level becomes sub.level for %T, reflect Type.String/PkgPath, gob names and messages that print type names (the alias keeps identity, not the name)

== INFO: package-level var initialiser calls pure constructors only ==
  hub/move.go:22: plain = ... calls fmt.Sprintf (allow-listed, with arguments that cannot run package code)
